summary.text: Nicole Cannizzaro is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General. A former Clark County criminal prosecutor, she is the Nevada state Senate majority leader and has held elected office for about a decade.

paragraphs.text: Worked as a criminal prosecutor in Clark County.
Has been in elected office for the past decade; currently Senate Majority Leader.

sources.title: Where do Nevada attorney general candidates stand on the issues?
To sue or not to sue: legal fights against feds a major theme in attorney general race
